units.title: Testing Nature with Numbers
units.blurb: Galileo's telescope and inclined plane; Newton's prism, telescope and laws of motion.

topics.title: Galileo: The Telescope and the Rolling Ball
topics.short: Galileo Galilei (1564–1642) built better telescopes from a rumor, saw the moons of Jupiter, and timed balls rolling down ramps.
topics.trouble: People repeat the Leaning Tower story as fact; it comes from a student's biography and may not have happened.

topics.title: Newton: Prisms, a New Telescope and the Laws of Motion
topics.short: Isaac Newton (1642–1727) split white light with prisms, built the first working reflecting telescope, and showed that one gravity rules apple and Moon.
topics.trouble: People think the prism adds colors to light; Newton showed white light is already a mixture.
